description.title: Check L1 to L2 bridge transfers on a given testnet
description.purpose:
Performs a nominal L1 to L2 bridge transfer using the L1 funded account on sepolia/ethereum to ensure that bridge transfers into TEN are operational.
Note that tests in the check category do not store any information into the e2e test database - they either just extract data from the database to perform the check, or get snapshots from the network.
